node.title: L1: below-band full-petal FPC5 residual payment
node.statement: At every official row and for every received word, after first-match assignment to one carried maximal sunflower source, the remaining full-petal contributors satisfying FPC5 admit one disjoint polynomial/profile allocation. The proved official partition has exactly three residual routers: the rate-half M=4,t=3 Johnson-nonpositive guarded LS6 slices; the M=4,t=2 rate split, whose rate-quarter branch is proved and whose only open child is rate half; and large sources M>=5,13,29,57 at rates 1/2,1/4,1/8,1/16 respectively. Conditional on aggregate payment of those three disjoint branches, the FPC5 target is proved. Mixed or partial petals are not part of this node.
node.attack_surface: pay the unbounded root-excess full-petal complement by the mu-basis/split-core-divisor, exact-shell Pade, or aggregate first-owner route without identifying source-petal count M with touched-petal count t
node.falsifier: a reserve-valid official-row family in FPC5 whose first-owner contribution exceeds every polynomial and every legitimate quotient/profile column
